design.photo_hint: Hombre sonriente con camiseta negra sosteniendo una laptop frente a él.

design.image_prompt: Photorealistic editorial portrait, featuring the exact face and precise facial features of the specific man from the identity reference photos (clean-cut fade haircut, exact facial structure and nose shape, short trimmed dark beard, small nose ring, NO earrings, NO hand tattoos), wearing a tailored teal-blue suit, white shirt, burgundy bow tie, and white pocket square. He holds a black geometric-patterned folder featuring the "Emprendeconvic" logo and "emprendeconvic.com", looking at the camera with a subtle smile, perfectly matching the exact composition, pose and layout of the layout reference image. Outdoor background with purple flowering trees, overlaid with text reading "[[kicker]]", main title "[[titulo]]", body text "[[descripcion]]", and handle "@vic.mercadeo". Soft natural editorial lighting, 8k resolution.
